name: youtube
description: Finds music videos on YouTube (InnerTube, YouTube Music's video search) and hands them to the app's official YouTube player (the IFrame embed on youtube-nocookie.com). Nothing is downloaded and no stream is resolved: YouTube plays the video itself, with its own ads and its own counting, and the player stays on screen while it plays — YouTube's rules (D-086). No yt-dlp. The cover is the video's own thumbnail from `i.ytimg.com`. The official video is taken over the artist's audio upload: YouTube's own search, at the same address, gives the uploads' titles; an upload that is only the song's sound (audio, lyrics, a visualizer, an art track) is not offered as its video (D-096).
